Sound2U v0.3.96

  Cooler live player
- Reduced the live equalizer refresh rate from the display refresh rate to four efficient visual updates per second.

- Save2U remains beside Wake2U.

apps.name: VAT24
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog:
VAT24 v1.0.21

  New
- Added optional Reliable Background Alerts.
- VAT24 can now keep checking selected notification types more reliably while the app is closed.
- Added configurable background check intervals of 15, 30 or 60 minutes.
- Added a dedicated low-priority foreground service for reliable local monitoring.

Notifications
- Existing notification types remain fully optional and independent.
- Emergency notifications can still be enabled or disabled separately.
- Followed flight notifications remain separately configurable.
- ATC online notifications remain separately configurable.
- VATSIM event notifications remain separately configurable.
- Airport weather notifications remain separately configurable.

Reliable monitoring
- Reliable Background Alerts can be enabled or disabled from Settings.
- A single foreground service handles the selected local background checks.
- The service only runs when at least one relevant notification type is enabled.
- The service automatically stops when no monitored notification type is active.
- Monitoring can resume after app updates and device restarts when Android permits.

Battery & performance
- No continuous polling loop.
- No one-minute heartbeat.
- VAT24 sleeps until the next configured monitoring interval.
- Network checks only run when a notification check is due.
- Multiple checks are combined where possible to reduce unnecessary network activity.
- Temporary network failures use a delayed retry instead of continuous retries.

Fallback
- When Reliable Background Alerts is disabled, VAT24 continues to use its existing WorkManager-based background checks.
- WorkManager and the foreground monitoring service do not perform the same local checks at the same time.

Notes
- The foreground service notification can be set to silent.
- Actual flight, emergency, ATC, weather and event notifications remain separate.
- Android Force Stop, restricted battery mode, no network connection or provider outages can still prevent background checks.

apps.name: Esmarty

apps.changelog: Esmarty changelog v0.5.4 - Provider links now open in Esmarty's own in-app browser by default instead of always handing the URL to Android's default browser. - Added automatic provider-page language detection and on-device translation with ML Kit. - Added website translation targets: System language, Dutch, English and Spanish. - Esmarty first prefers an official provider language variant when one is advertised by the site; otherwise it translates the visible page text. - Added Original / Translate switching plus an explicit Open in browser action. - Login, authentication, cart, checkout and payment flows are handed back to the user's normal browser. - Added an Esmarty settings dialog for in-app browser and translation preferences. - Fixed system theme handling: Esmarty now uses the dark palette when Android dark mode is enabled and the light palette otherwise. - The embedded browser follows system dark mode using WebView algorithmic darkening where supported. - Added explicit day/night system-bar styling. - Updated app version to 0.5.4 (versionCode 10).

apps.name: Weather2U
apps.description: Modern weather app with forecasts, rain radar, official warnings, widgets and smart background alerts.
apps.changelog:
Weather2U v2.4.6

New
- Added Reliable Background Alerts mode.
- Weather2U can now keep monitoring weather alerts while the app is closed.
- Added configurable monitoring intervals of 15, 30 or 60 minutes.
- Rain alerts and official weather warnings can use separate monitoring intervals.
- Added configurable warning threshold: yellow, orange or red.

Background monitoring
- Added an optional foreground service for more reliable background checks.
- The service sleeps between scheduled checks to minimize battery usage.
- Rain and warning checks are combined whenever possible.
- Uses the last known location without continuously requesting GPS.
- Monitoring automatically resumes after device restart or app update.
- Reliable monitoring continues when Weather2U is removed from the recent apps screen.

Notifications
- Added a dedicated silent notification channel for the monitoring service.
- The persistent monitoring notification can be set to silent.
- Actual rain and weather warning notifications remain separate.
- When Reliable Background Alerts is disabled, Weather2U falls back to WorkManager.

Performance
- Preserved cache-first weather loading for faster startup.
- Existing cached weather remains visible while fresh data is downloaded.
- Reduced unnecessary background work and duplicate network requests.

Battery
- No continuous GPS tracking.
- No constant polling loop.
- Network requests only run at the configured monitoring intervals.

apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.description: Live aircraft spotting met vliegtuigfoto's, kaart, slimme meldingen en uitgebreide spotterfuncties.
apps.changelog:
SkyRadar 1.0.0-alpha13.0

- Completely redesigned Material 3 interface.
- Nearby aircraft is now the default home screen.
- Aircraft cards show photos, distance, altitude, speed, registration and aircraft type.
- Tap an aircraft to open and select it directly on the live map.
- Added smart proximity notifications.
- Filter notifications by radius, airline and aircraft type.
- Added maximum altitude filters.
- Added favorite aircraft registrations and alerts.
- Added special aircraft filtering for aircraft such as the A380, Boeing 747, Antonov and military traffic.
- Added likely-overflight detection using distance, altitude, speed and heading.
- Added Spotter section with Favorites and Today.
- Today records nearby aircraft including minimum distance and time of passage.
- Improved aircraft photo matching and caching.
- Improved location updates, navigation and overall stability.

apps.name: Customer Nearby
apps.description: Wereldwijde klantenservicezoeker met telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail, websites en storingsinformatie.
apps.changelog: Customer Nearby 0.2.13 - Added direct curated Netherlands customer-service call actions for DELTA (0118 22 55 75), Ziggo (0900 1884) and Odido (0800 0092), while retaining existing KPN/Vodafone/Guidion profiles. - Added Odido's international service number and normalized current first-party support routes for Ziggo and Odido. - Booking.com NL now shows a descriptive Bericht of bel 24/7 action that opens Booking.com's official localized support flow instead of inventing a fixed phone number. - Contact-cache schema bumped to 7 so older sparse cached profiles cannot hide new curated contact actions. - Split outage routing into a user-facing preferred status URL and a separate regional automatic-detection URL. - KPN, Ziggo, Odido and DELTA now open verified first-party status/service checkers from the outage UI where available. - Added DELTA to the Netherlands outage catalogue. - Added a 30-minute per-country automatic backoff after regional outage-source 403/429 responses, preventing repeated Home/company-open retries against a temporarily blocked source. - Manual outage refresh may still explicitly retry; failed/unparseable checks remain UNKNOWN and never become false outage cards. - Added Dutch/English/Spanish strings for the new official-status and Booking.com contact UI. - Version bumped to 0.2.13 / versionCode 17.

apps.name: Data2U
apps.description: Smart mobile data tracking with app usage, SIM/eSIM insights, roaming, forecasts and widgets.
apps.changelog:
Data2U v0.5.2

  Fixed

- Fixed Speed2U DNS failures on some Android devices and custom ROMs.
- Improved network validation before starting a Speed2U test.
- Speed2U now skips stale or unusable Android network routes.
- Added a safe mobile-network fallback when the default active network cannot resolve DNS.
- Wi-Fi tests remain locked to Wi-Fi and will not silently switch to mobile data.
- Active VPN connections are respected and are not bypassed.

Carrier database
- Improved remote carrier database reliability.
- Data2U now loads carrier_profiles.json from the GetMe repository.
- Added a GitHub API fallback when raw.githubusercontent.com cannot be reached.
- Improved handling of remote database errors.
- Data2U now reports when the installed carrier database is already up to date instead of showing a generic update failure.
- The built-in European carrier database remains available as an offline fallback.

UI
- Carrier Max Speed remains compact and focused on provider, maximum download and maximum upload information.
- Updated provider database status messaging for clearer diagnostics.

Privacy & battery
- No new background services or periodic speed tests added.
- Speed2U remains fully user-initiated.
- Carrier database checks remain lightweight and infrequent.
